Legal

Privacy policy

GOSBLO respects your privacy and collects only the information needed to respond to an enquiry and operate this website securely.

Information you provide

If you use the contact form, we receive your name, email address, optional phone number and message. This information is used only to respond to your enquiry and conduct any resulting business relationship.

Technical information

Amazon Web Services may process limited request information, such as IP address, browser type and request time, to deliver and protect the site. Application logs are retained for 30 days and do not include contact message bodies or contact fields.

Cookies and analytics

This site does not use advertising, analytics, tracking cookies or third-party marketing scripts.

Service providers

The website is hosted on Amazon Web Services in Sydney, Australia. Contact messages are delivered using Amazon Simple Email Service. These providers process information only to supply the relevant infrastructure services.

Retention and access

Enquiry information is retained only as long as reasonably needed to respond, meet legal obligations and maintain business records. You may ask to access or correct your information by using the contact form.
